description: This file defines the ChaosAgentCommand class, which is a command-line command for managing chaos testing (shutting down or restarting servers) in a distributed environment. It uses System.CommandLine for CLI parsing, handles parameters for service and cluster IDs, URIs, and operation options, and implements the logic to send control messages over a messaging channel.

classes.name: ChaosAgentCommand
classes.description: A command class for executing chaos testing commands such as server shutdown or restart based on specified parameters.

methods.name: RunAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous method executing the chaos command process: creating a communication channel, iterating over rounds, and sending control messages.
